macros.name: breakforeach
macros.doc: If this command is given inside a \foreach command, no further executions of the ⟨commands⟩ will occur.

macros.name: foreach
macros.doc: The general syntax is \foreach ⟨variable⟩ in {⟨list of values⟩} ⟨commands⟩. Inside the ⟨commands⟩, the ⟨variable⟩ will be assigned to the different values.
